execution.note: A decision made on session D's close fills at the open of the next NYSE session after D, plus half-spread and square-root impact (ai-hedge-fund TradingCosts), plus commission.

decision_policy.rules: BUY needs Merlin BULLISH with conviction >= min_conviction and a Quant verdict of AGREE or PARTIALLY_AGREE and a Quant stance that is not BEARISH. DISAGREE never adds exposure; with an existing position it REDUCEs to the partial weight when Quant is BEARISH. INCONCLUSIVE or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE gives NO_ACTION.

guards.note: Checks before buying (merlin_quant/guards.py). Each can only turn a BUY into WAIT; sales are never blocked. 'block' holds the buy back, 'flag' only shows the warning. stale data: an earnings 8-K (item 2.02) newer than the latest 10-Q/10-K, or a latest quarter older than max_quarter_age_days. Earnings window: no new buys from pre_sessions before to post_sessions after a report (owner dates in earnings_dates win over the estimate from 8-K history). Market: block when SPY (or QQQ, if in the data) falls index_1d_drop in a session, index_5d_drop over five sessions, or sits index_drawdown below its 20-session high, or when the stock trails SPY by stock_vs_market_5d over five sessions.
